item.title: BOYS AND GIRLS CLUB OF HENDERSON COUNTY NAMES LUNA TREJO-LUGO AS 2026 YOUTH OF THE YEAR
item.description: The Boys and Girls Club of Henderson County has named Luna Trejo-Lugo as its "Youth of the Year" for 2026. This prestigious title is the highest honor a teen can receive from the organization, as it recognizes outstanding leadership, character, academic excellence, service and commitment to a healthy lifestyle. BUILD HENDERSONVILLE NEW PARTICIPATORY BUDGET PROGRAM IN THE CITY OF HENDERSONVILLE
item.description: – The City of Hendersonville is making its budget process moreinteractive than ever with the launch of a new participatory budgeting program called BuildHendersonville. The City is setting aside $25,000 for residents to decide how the funds should be used to improve thecommunity. item.title: SECOND WEEK OF WINTER CLEANUP CONTINUES IN HENDERSON COUNTY AS CREWS BATTLE FRIGID WINDS
item.description: In Henderson County, from the North Carolina Department of Transportation to private contractor crews, it was the second week of winter weather cleanup. To give crews more time to make primary and secondary roadways passable, both Henderson County and Hendersonville have closed government offices on Monday, Feb. 2, for non-essential workers.
